name: Swing Through Grass
statusMeaning: Calls something that is on Kiln's roadmap. Parts of it may already run.
author: Nikrecs
description: Swing through grass to hit mobs: attacks no longer get eaten by tall grass, ferns and plants, so your sword reaches the target through foliage. Lightweight, server-side, no client needed
evidence: Server-side mod: Kiln runs mods' code on Horizon's single-player server, not on dedicated servers.
